name: @battuta/api
description: The plugin contract of the battuta host: manifest, activation, context, command messages. Imports nothing of the editor; from core, only the plain-data document types it re-exports.
//: prepare is LOAD-BEARING (same as @battuta/core): the editor and every plugin resolve @battuta/api via dist/, and npm install/ci runs prepare in workspaces. The build is `tsc -b` over a project reference to core, so core's declarations exist before the api compiles whatever order npm runs the workspaces' prepare in (slice 1's CI failure was that order).

Core owns the document's data types (caret, block, pitch, syllable, harmony kind); document.ts re-exports exactly those, type-only, and nothing else of core reaches a plugin (decided 2026-09-15). Nothing of core reaches the api's runtime.
The version is the API version plugins declare in engines.battuta. Any change to the public types (api-report.d.ts) requires bumping it — the surface test refuses otherwise.
